import { CoreTransactionResult, PersistentTransactionResult } from "@picodash/nexus";
export declare function connectPicodashDevBridge(options: PicodashDevBridgeConnectOptions): Promise<PicodashDevBridgeBrowserConnection>;
export declare function connectPicodashDevBridgeFromBroker<Fields extends import('@picodash/nexus').PicodashFieldDefinitions, Result extends CoreTransactionResult | PersistentTransactionResult = CoreTransactionResult>(options: Omit<PicodashDevBridgeConnectOptions<Fields, Result>, 'credential'> & {
  readonly brokerUrl?: string;
  readonly development: boolean;
}): Promise<{
  status: 'disabled';
  close: () => Promise<void>;
} | {
  session: PicodashDevBridgeSessionDescriptor;
  close: () => Promise<void>;
  status: 'connected';
}>;
